card.name: Commas and digits inside dates and citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation or small words just before a year or number in a citation or parenthetical date, such as the comma after a day and month in a historical date. Also the start of a number inside a bibliographic reference.

modes.label: Comma before a year
modes.description: The comma after a day and month in a parenthetical historical date, right before the year.
modes.example: assassination of Henry III by Jacques Clément (1 August<<,>> 1589), the mother

modes.label: Citation details
modes.description: Place, page, or author markers in references where a number or year follows.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: A pronoun or linking word after 'but' or 'and' that starts a new clause.
modes.example: but<< you>> can use other systems management applications to alert
